review_candidates.description: Org Marketing Statement At Parker Aerospace, we develop technologies and innovative solutions that enable reliable, efficient and increasingly sustainable flight for the lifecycle of the aircraft, including aftermarket support. Our passionate people with deep engineering expertise, together with our breadth of differentiated technologies, ensure that we make the extraordinary happen and continue to shape the future of aviation in partnership with our customers. Services & Support Operations Division The Services and Support Operations (SSO) is a global leader of integrated MRO services and support. We are renowned for our exceptional customer service and expertise at every stage of the aircraft lifecycle, providing innovative OEM-quality service solutions across a comprehensive portfolio. We are proud to serve airlines/ business jet operators, the military, airframe/ engine manufacturers, as well as independent service centers. With our extensive network of service teams worldwide, MRO facilities, proprietary predictive modeling, and advanced systems, we offer 24/7 operational and technical support wherever it's needed. Customer Service Engineer II (SSO Division – Location: Simi Valley, CA) Position Summary The Customer Support Engineer II provides experienced-level technical engineering support for in-service Parker products, customers, and internal stakeholders. This role serves as a technical liaison for OEM/Prime customers, airlines, operators, Maintenance Repair and Overhaul (MRO) organizations, Technical Publications, Sales and Service Organizations, and internal engineering, quality, operations, program, commercial, and warranty teams. The position supports product reliability, system performance monitoring, customer satisfaction, aftermarket readiness, failure analysis, warranty adjudication, technical documentation, Entry into Service (EIS) activities, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Customer Support Engineer II works with limited to minimal supervision, applies disciplined analytical problem-solving methods to assignments of moderate-to-difficult scope, interprets engineering drawings and specifications, and communicates technical information clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Scope/Supervision and Interaction Works under limited to minimal supervision on routine and moderately complex assignments. Applies engineering judgment, established procedures, technical standards, and customer support practices to resolve product and service issues. Escalates highly complex, safety-critical, regulatory, or business-sensitive issues to senior engineering, quality, or management personnel. Interacts regularly with OEM/Prime customers, airlines, operators, MRO organizations, suppliers, field support personnel, and internal Parker functions. Collaborates with Engineering, Product Design, Reliability, Manufacturing, Quality, MRO, Program Management, Customer Support, Technical Publications, Contracts, Warranty, Commercial, and Sales and Service Organizations. May provide technical guidance to less experienced employees, technicians, or support personnel. Does not have direct supervisory responsibility. Essential Functions Provides technical engineering support for in-service Parker products used by OEM/Prime customers, airlines, operators, and internal or external MRO organizations. Responds to customer technical inquiries related to product operation, performance, installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, reliability, serviceability, and repair. Serves as a technical subject matter resource for internal teams and external customers regarding assigned products or one solution line. Supports customer meetings, technical reviews, product investigations, field issue resolution, and customer communication activities. Monitors system and product performance, field data, removals, warranty returns, repair activity, customer scorecards, and repair performance metrics to identify adverse trends and improvement opportunities. Analyzes reliability and performance data; prepares technical summaries, reliability reports, customer metrics, presentations, and recommendations for internal and external stakeholders. Conducts or supports root cause analysis (RCA), unit investigations, teardown reviews, failure analysis, and corrective action activities for returned or in-service products. Evaluates field issues using structured problem-solving methods, test data, maintenance records, inspection results, service bulletins, customer-provided information, and product history. Coordinates with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Suppliers, MRO, and field support teams to identify causes, containment actions, corrective actions, preventive actions, and long-term improvement plans. Supports continuous improvement initiatives related to product reliability, maintainability, repair performance, warranty reduction, cost of ownership, technical support processes, and customer satisfaction. Interprets and applies engineering drawings, specifications, test procedures, product standards, configuration requirements, and technical documentation. Coordinates with Technical Publications and applicable engineering teams to review and improve service information, troubleshooting guidance, maintenance instructions, customer-facing technical publications, and Instructions for Continued Airworthiness, where applicable. Supports aftermarket readiness planning for new products, product changes, upgrades, and Entry into Service activities, including spares considerations, repair readiness, troubleshooting procedures, customer support materials, training needs, and MRO capability requirements. Provides technical input for product support plans, service strategies, customer readiness reviews, field support plans, and internal or customer training. Supports warranty adjudication by reviewing technical evidence, product history, failure analysis results, contractual requirements, and customer claims. Provides technical input for contract review activities related to customer support requirements, reliability commitments, service obligations, warranty terms, and product support expectations. Uses Microsoft Office, data analysis tools, business software, CAD/CAM, product lifecycle management systems, configuration tools, ERP systems, or other engineering applications as required to analyze, document, and communicate technical information. Maintains awareness of applicable aerospace, aftermarket, maintenance, repair, and continued airworthiness requirements, including Part 21, Part 145, and related regulatory expectations where applicable. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related engineering field. 2–5 years of relevant engineering experience, preferably in aerospace, manufacturing, product support, customer support engineering, reliability, MRO, aftermarket support, or field service engineering. Working to proficient knowledge of engineering concepts, practices, and procedures for one solution line or assigned product area. Demonstrated ability to apply disciplined analytical problem-solving methods to issues of moderate-to-difficult scope. Knowledge of continuous improvement methods and ability to support corrective action, preventive action, process improvement, and product performance improvement activities. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, schematics, test procedures, inspection records, maintenance data, and technical publications. Familiarity with GD&T, configuration management, product lifecycle management systems, and engineering change processes, where applicable. Experience or working knowledge of CAD/CAM, product data systems, data analysis tools, reporting tools, ERP systems, or other relevant engineering and business software. Ability to analyze technical and business data, identify product or process trends, and develop fact-based conclusions and recommendations. Knowledge of root cause analysis tools such as 5-Why, fishbone diagrams, fault tree analysis, 8D, or similar structured methods. Ability to prepare clear technical reports, customer communications, reliability summaries, presentations, and investigation documentation. Strong stakeholder communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, MRO, Program Management, Customer Support, Technical Publications, Contracts, Warranty, Commercial, and Sales and Service Organizations. Aerospace, aftermarket, airline, operator, OEM/Prime customer, or MRO knowledge preferred where applicable. Awareness of aerospace regulatory frameworks, including Part 21, Part 145, and Instructions for Continued Airworthiness, preferred where applicable. Ability to manage multiple assignments, priorities, investigations, deadlines, and stakeholder expectations with minimal supervision. This position is subject to meeting U.S. export compliance and/or U.S. Government contracting citizenship eligibility requirements. Must be a US Citizen. Drug-Free Workplace In accordance with Parker’s policies and applicable state laws, Parker provides for a drug-free workplace. Therefore, all applicants seeking employment with Parker will be subject to drug testing as a condition of employment. Conditions of Employment This position is subject to meeting U.S. export compliance and/or U.S. Government contracting citizenship eligibility requirements. Competitive Compensation Pay, Benefits, Work Schedule Pay Range: $84915 to $141320 annually Participation in Annual Incentive Program Benefit & Retirement Plans Parker Offers Competitive Benefit Programs, Including Comprehensive coverage for medical, prescription drugs, dental, vision, voluntary optional life, accident insurance, hospital indemnity insurance and critical illness insurance with competitive premium cost. 401(k) Plan with company matching contributions at 100% of the first 5% of pay. Company provided defined-contribution retirement plan with annual contribution equal to 3% of pay. Career development and tuition reimbursement. Other benefits including paid parental leave, short and long-term disability programs, adoption assistance, a Care.com membership and financial planning assistance are provided at no cost to you. Supplemental benefit programs including identity protection, legal protection, and pet wellness are available at competitive rates. Paid Time Off and Company-Paid Holidays. At Sovos, we're transforming tax compliance from a business requirement into a driver of growth through AI-powered technology that delivers the accurate, real-time insights businesses need to make smarter decisions. We're helping reshape global economies by enabling organizations to manage increasingly complex and rapidly changing regulatory environments with confidence – and helping communities thrive. AI is accelerating what's possible, enabling tax and technology professionals to more effectively drive critical regulatory decisions. That's where Sovos excels, combining intelligent technology with human expertise to help customers stay ahead of change. Don't worry if you don't check every box. We're focused on hiring great people, not perfect resumes. It's less about what you've done elsewhere and more about what you're capable of doing here. The Role At Sovos, we're transforming how businesses manage complex global compliance. This Pre-Sales Engineer role sits at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical advisory, supporting multi-country sales engagements across our tax and compliance technology portfolio. You'll act as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers, leading discovery, designing scalable solutions, and positioning the business value of our platform. More Specifically, You Will Lead complex, multi-entity discovery sessions across global customer organisations, mapping transaction flows, ERP landscapes, and regulatory exposure. Design scalable, cross-border solution architectures aligned to business and compliance needs, positioning commercial value alongside technical functionality. Influence technical and business stakeholders, including senior decision-makers, and partner with Sales to shape account strategy and advance deals through structured qualification. Own technical responses for enterprise RFPs, RFIs and global tenders, and deliver tailored demonstrations reflecting global regulatory and ERP scenarios. Operate as a trusted advisor in partner-led and embedded solution models, collaborating cross-functionally to ensure seamless transition from pre-sales to implementation. Contribute to global pre-sales best practices, messaging, and competitive positioning, and maintain high-quality demo environments aligned with market requirements. Leverage AI tools to improve discovery workflows, automate response generation, and enhance demonstration personalisation. What You Bring to Sovos You can lead structured discovery sessions, design scalable solutions, and confidently influence enterprise buying decisions You're skilled at leading structured discovery and solution mapping conversations, with a commercial mindset and the ability to influence customer buying decisions. Experience navigating ERP ecosystems is highly desirable; exposure to tax, compliance, regulatory, finance or adjacent domains is advantageous. You're comfortable operating autonomously with appropriate support with limited regional infrastructure, working effectively across time zones and global teams. You have strong written and verbal communication skills in English and French, and you're willing to travel occasionally. Comfort with AI-assisted workflows and tools that enhance pre-sales efficiency and personalisation is a plus. Due to client contractual obligations, the successful candidate will be asked to clear a background check upon hire. The Process We believe in a transparent and comprehensive hiring process. Here's what you might expect: 1 Pre-Employment Assessment Regionally specific assessments we use to mitigate bias and give every applicant a fair shot. 2 Video Interview A chance to meet as many qualified applicants as possible and get to know you beyond your resume. 3 Meeting with a Recruiter A conversation to talk through the role, your experience, and your goals. 4 Live Interviews with the Hiring Team Meet the people you'll work with and dig into the day-to-day of the role. Global Mentoring Programs AI Tools and Technology from Day 1 Continuous Learning and Development Language Learning Support Global Employee Recognition Platform and Programs Global Parental Leave Policy 30 days holiday plus bank holidays Private Health Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Coverage Life Insurance Critical Illness Cover Income Protection Pension with employer contribution Employee Assistance Programme Equal Opportunity Employer Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to contribute authentically and be valued for their unique perspectives and backgrounds. Our flagship product, the Sovos Compliance Cloud platform, enables businesses to identify, determine, and report on every tax obligation across the globe. Sovos processes nearly 20 billion transactions per year, helping companies scale their compliance strategy in 150+ countries. More than 100,000 customers – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos’ tax and regulatory expertise and unparalleled integration with their business applications. Learn more at sovos.com. review_candidates.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Performance - UK
review_candidates.description: About Teleport Don't wait for the future of infrastructure. Be part of it. Teleport is the AI Infrastructure Identity Company. We're solving one of the hardest problems in security: giving every human, machine, workload, and AI agent a cryptographically secured identity, improving engineering velocity while maintaining security. We make trusted computing simple. This gives you the freedom, power, and autonomy to build and innovate with confidence. Remote-first and globally distributed, we work with companies like Nasdaq, DoorDash, and Elastic to secure infrastructure for an AI world. About The Role We are looking for product-focused systems engineers to work on Teleport Core Product. You will work on problems ranging from performance and scalability, security and networking, to integrations with external systems. You will work on the full product lifecycle from working with customers to understand their problems, writing RFDs for your proposed design, implementing, testing, and documenting. Teleport is an open core project, and most of the code you will write will be open source and written in Go. What You'll Do Become an expert on scalability, performance, and reliability of Teleport in large deployments. Design, develop, and ship outstanding, high-quality products. Write most of the code in Go. Closely collaborate with other teams at Teleport on matters related to scalability and performance. Work directly with our customers to diagnose and remediate performance issues. Grow your technical expertise. What We're Looking For Willingness to work collaboratively with Teleport's engineers on coding challenge in Go as part of the interview process. Builder mentality and experience -- you love building zero-to-one products Extensive Go experience. Extensive experience developing scalable, reliable, and performant distributed systems and platforms. Linux systems engineering experience. Knowledge of Identity Management, RBAC, ABAC, and zero-trust security models. Intellectual curiosity and a willingness to master new technologies. Transparency, honesty, and a no-ego mindset. Significant contributions in Open Source is a big plus. How We Hire Our process is designed to be straightforward and respectful of your time. We skip performative rounds and focus on what matters: understanding how you think and what you can do. For this role, we use a take-home challenge that mirrors real work at Teleport — on your time, your way. You'll have support from the team throughout. Video meeting with a Teleport recruiter. You’ll learn about the company, our products, compensation philosophy, interview process, and key requirements. Video meeting with the Hiring Manager. The Hiring Manager will walk you through the coding challenge and answer your questions. Coding challenge collaboration. The day after your meeting with the Hiring Manager, you join a Slack channel and complete a coding challenge in Go using GitHub. The challenge usually takes about 2 weeks and ends with a Zoom meeting with the Hiring Manager and a member of the interview team to review your solution. If your challenge solution meets our bar, you'll receive an offer to join Teleport. Why Teleport You're joining a company where the problem is real, the team is small, and your work shows up directly in the product. We're not a big company, you won't get lost in a crowd. You'll have the freedom and autonomy to do what you're great at, alongside teammates who care about doing it right and want to see you succeed. The work is collaborative, there's real room to grow, and the mission is one worth showing up for. Remote-first and globally distributed, we're genuinely passionate about what we're building. The Benefits At Teleport, we believe your career is more important than a list of perks. That's why we focus on making your day-to-day the best it can be — giving you the autonomy, access, and support to do the best work of your career. Extensive health coverage Annual expense budget Rest and recovery policies that maximize your ability to recharge Investment in your future with retirement savings plans Professional development opportunities Teleport is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, color, disability, gender, national origin, race, religion, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classifications protected by federal, state, or local law. Candidate Privacy Notice: For information about our collection and processing of job applicant personal data for this position, please see our Job Applicant Privacy Policy and Notice of Collection at goteleport.com/legal/apply/job-applicant/ Compensation Range: £144K - £204.6K

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer, Platform Experience
review_candidates.description: Meet Siena Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns. It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on. The team We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do. We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock. If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading. The Role You take the hardest problems customers hit in production and solve them end to end: a webhook that stopped firing, an agent filling the wrong parameter, a report that won't reconcile. You find the real cause, work the customer to resolution, then build the automation so it doesn't come back. This is the front door to deployment and platform work at Siena, with a clear path into Forward Deployed Engineering or deeper platform work. What You'll Do Own hard problems end to end: trace, reproduce, fix, or hand engineering a clean reproduction. Get on the call when that's the fastest path Debug the agents and the prompts. Diagnose whether a misfire is prompt, knowledge base, config, or model, then fix it so it holds under real traffic Build so it doesn't happen twice. For every fix, ship the runbook or tool that stops it recurring Close the loop to Product. Surface patterns, not one-offs, backed by metrics Raise the team's floor. Lift what the whole team can resolve, not just what you can Know where your scope ends. Escalate genuine product bugs and outages with a clean reproduction, not a shrug Within 90 days, name the top recurring failure patterns and attack them at the root, not just patch symptoms Who You Are The Bar: I f you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you. You solve problems end to end. Given a customer, some logs, and a vague symptom, you find the break and can tell a customer-side cause from a product bug You're fluent with AI agents and prompts. You've built or debugged LLM workflows and know how they break: prompts, knowledge bases, retrieval, the gap between test and live You're excited to build automation, not just fix what's in front of you. You think in leverage. This is the signal that matters most Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one. You like talking to customers. You'll get on a call and resolve the real problem live, not just the reported one Comfortable in our core stack (Node.js, TypeScript, React, Express) or close enough to ramp fast Fluent with AI coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent) to script, clean data, or navigate a new codebase fast You own problems nobody assigned you, and you make the people around you better through docs and walkthroughs Nice to Have: Bonus, not required. Observability tooling (Grafana, Honeycomb, Sentry) Internal tooling that turned manual work into a system Ecommerce or DTC exposure Not a Fit If: You stop at "it's not our bug" instead of finding the real cause You'd rather build the fix than talk to the customer who hit it You want a backlog of well-scoped tickets, not ambiguous production fires Why Siena? Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox. Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast. A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in. A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one. Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build. Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we. AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster. Our values The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite. They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward. Our approach to AI The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem. Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows. At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application. How We Hire We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at talent@siena.cx. Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.
